vo.text: Coding has changed. With today's frontier AI models, one person can build what used to take a whole team.
But AI writes code fast... and someone still has to know if it's right.
That someone could be you. The coding track.
Learn the fundamentals, so you can read, fix and trust any code.
Build real web and mobile apps, and ship them with AI tools.
Go from your very first line of code to apps people actually use.
A few minutes a day, with instant feedback, streaks and leagues to keep you going.
In this new world, you won't just use apps. You'll build them.
It all launches this November! Free to start.
Get notified at teyro dot app, and be first in!
